messages:
maya: Heads-up — for the Q3 private pilot we need to unpin default model routing from `redwood-instruct-v2` -> `redwood-instruct-v3-quant`. Need a sequencing plan across product/eng/runtime/infra/security. Who owns the unpin rollout and prewarm?
sam: I can own runtime rollout. Quick q: do we want a strict canary (1% -> 10% -> 100%) or a more aggressive ramp? Also any latency SLO changes with the quant path?
maya: Canary is fine. Launch criteria from product: p95 <= 350ms on Dedicated, error rate < 0.5%, no QA regressions on our eval set. Also must clear security review for KMS/HSM compatibility before full rollout.
alex: Infra: we'll need reserved GPU capacity for canary bursts and a prewarm window. Can you confirm expected peak QPS and prewarm duration? Also does quant use CPU fallback for long contexts?
maya: Expected peak ~120 r/s during pilot bursts, steady ~40 r/s. Prewarm window: 10 minutes before each major ramp. Preferred hardware: A100 for dedicated, but can fall back to T4 for short bursts.
sam: Runtime note: quant variant lowers mem usage but short-seq kernel latency is ~+8%. Suggest rollout policy in manifest: 
```
- 0-10m: canary 1% (monitor p95, errors)
- 10-60m: 10%
- 60-180m: 50%
- >180m: 100% if metrics green
```
riley: Security: we need KMS audit logs and an HSM key-wrap test in staging. Also run a KV-cache threat surface review — ensure no customer keys persist in shared caches.
taylor: Product: add automated rollback conditions — if p95 > 500ms OR error_rate > 1% for 5m => immediate rollback. Also block if eval-set quality regression >1%.
jordan: SRE: add tracing hooks and paging rules. Keep `trace_id` across proxy. Alerting thresholds proposed: 
- p95 > 450ms => P1
- error rate > 1% => P1
- deployment failure 3 consecutive instances => P0
alex: I'll open an infra PR to pin capacity: `infra/allocations/pilot-aurora.json` with GPU pool, prewarm schedule, and autoscale caps. ETA EOD tomorrow.
sam: I'll add a feature flag in config repo: `ff:pilot/unpin_redwood_instruct_v3` and a rollout manifest with metric checks and rollback hooks.
maya: @alex can you confirm prewarm job command and exact slot counts so I can commit to the customer prewarm window?
alex: Prewarm command (staging run): 
```
kubectl run prewarm-pilot --image=prewarm:latest --requests='gpu:0.25' --replicas=4 --env="MODEL=redwood-instruct-v3-quant"
```
Slots: reserve 8 vGPUs for the 10-min prewarm and 16 during the 50% ramp. Will add to PR.
riley: Security will run HSM wrap/unwrap test in staging tomorrow 09:00 PT. If wrap/unwrap fails, rollout is blocked until resolved.
taylor: Also require acceptance checks: E2E sample prompt set must pass and embeddings drift < 0.02 on our baseline. Add that to the eval checklist.
maya: Owners recap: runtime = sam, infra = alex, security = riley, product = taylor/maya. Next steps: alex -> infra PR, sam -> runtime rollout manifest, riley -> schedule HSM test, taylor -> create eval checklist. Target pilot canary Thu 10:00 PT.
sam: Thu 10:00 PT works. I'll add dashboards and a short canary runbook with exact queries.
alex: I'll try to get PR up by EOD tomorrow and tag @sam @riley @taylor.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: pilot-prep job created for Thu 09:45 PT (ID: job-38950012) :white_check_mark:
maya: Thanks — I'll post a final call doc in #product on Wed and ping everyone again. :thumbsup:
